quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #17
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 15

questions.question: Which of the following blocks traffic flow?

options.text: Slowing down to look at a crash.
Using public transportation instead of driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slowing down to look at a crash.
questions.explanation: Slowing down to look at crashes causes traffic congestion and should be avoided.

questions.question: You must signal every time you pull away from a curb.
questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: You must use your turn signal every time you pull away from a curb.

questions.question: You want to park downhill on a two-way road with no curb. Which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Right, toward the edge of the road
Left, toward the center of the road

questions.correctAnswerText: Right, toward the edge of the road
questions.explanation: When parking downhill with no curb, or uphill with no curb, turn your wheels toward the road edge. This way, your vehicle will roll away from traffic if the brakes fail. When parking uphill with a curb, turn wheels toward the center so your vehicle rolls into the curb if the brakes fail.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while you are driving. You should:

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the engine.
Turn on hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer firmly, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: If power steering fails, you will need extra effort to steer. Slow down and drive to a safe place to stop.

questions.question: Why is extra space in front of a large truck important?

options.text: To let other drivers merge onto the freeway.
To give the truck driver room to stop.
To help other drivers when they want to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: To give the truck driver room to stop.
questions.explanation: Trucks take longer to stop than cars at the same speed. Do not cut in front of a truck and then slow down or stop.

questions.question: You are in a left turn lane at an intersection with oncoming traffic. You should:

options.text: Move to the left of the center lane.
Signal before you reach the intersection.
Turn your front wheels left to prepare for the turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal before you reach the intersection.
questions.explanation: Signal about 100 feet before you turn. Keep your front wheels straight until it is safe to turn. This protects you if another vehicle hits you from behind.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A steep hill is ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming and you should adjust your speed.

questions.question: Hydroplaning happens when tires slide on a water film instead of gripping the road. What should you do in rain to prevent hydroplaning?

options.text: Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Move to the shoulder as soon as rain starts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Reduce your speed in rain to avoid hydroplaning. Driving too fast can cause your tires to lose contact with the road, making your vehicle hard to control.

questions.question: How fast you drive does not affect how far your vehicle travels after you brake.
questions.correctAnswerText: FALSE
questions.explanation: Higher speeds require longer stopping distances. Stay far behind the vehicle in front of you.

questions.question: You see a flashing red light at an intersection. You should:

options.text: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Stop only if other cars are approaching.
Stop only if other cars are in the intersection.
Slow down and stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. You must stop completely, yield the right-of-way, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should drive with caution.

questions.question: Motorcycles are entitled to:

options.text: A full lane width, like all other vehicles.
Half the width of a lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: A full lane width, like all other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have the right to use the full width of a lane, just like all other vehicles.

questions.question: In bad weather, increase your following distance to:
questions.correctAnswerText: Four seconds.
questions.explanation: A larger distance between your vehicle and others gives you more time to react. Use at least four seconds of following distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light warns that a steady red light is coming next.

questions.question: If you are driving near a large commercial vehicle, you should:

options.text: Follow it closely to reduce wind drag on your vehicle.
Avoid driving beside it for long periods.
Drive on its right side when on curves and hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid driving beside it for long periods.
questions.explanation: Large commercial vehicles have large blind spots on both sides. Do not drive beside them for long periods of time.

questions.question: To see better in rain or fog, drivers should use their:
questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in rain or fog. Low beams help other drivers see you, even if they don't help you see much better.

questions.question: What can you do to avoid making emergency stops while driving in traffic?

options.text: Honk your horn to alert other drivers.
Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
Drive in the right lane only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look ahead and keep a safe distance from other cars.
questions.explanation: A safe following distance lets you react to problems without emergency stops, which could cause the driver behind you to crash into your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: T intersection.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs mark school zones and crossings. Stay alert and be ready to stop when you see these signs.

questions.question: The posted maximum speed limit is the fastest you can drive in an area.
questions.correctAnswerText: True
questions.explanation: The posted speed limit is the fastest legal speed under ideal conditions. You must slow down when conditions are bad, such as when the road is wet or visibility is poor.
